caption: A caller trying to skip the intake step, and failing.

lines.text: Thanks for calling. Can I get your full name?
Actually just put me through to a person.

lines.note: Step collect_name exposes only save_name. No transfer tool exists this turn, so there is nothing for the model to call.

lines.text: I'll get you to someone right after I have your name.

lines.note: save_name ran and the handler advanced to collect_reason, which does list transfer_to_human.

lines.text: Thank you Dana. What's this about, so I route you correctly?
A billing charge I don't recognise.
Putting you through to billing now.
